summary.text: A mean is a quantity representing the center of a collection of numbers, lying between the extreme values of the set.
The most commonly used kind is the arithmetic mean, the sum divided by the count: for 2, 3, 4, 7 and 9 it is 25 divided by 5, which is 5.
Which kind of average is most illuminating depends on what is measured; the median suits skewed data and the harmonic mean suits rates such as speeds.

facts.label: Arithmetic mean
facts.value: The sum divided by the count

facts.label: Sample mean
facts.value: Name for a mean taken from a sample of a larger group

facts.label: Harmonic mean
facts.value: The reciprocal of the mean of the reciprocals

facts.label: Bounds
facts.value: Every average lies between the maximum and minimum

items.prompt: Four test scores are 1, 2, 3 and 10. What is their arithmetic mean?
items.explain: The arithmetic mean is the sum divided by the count: 16 divided by 4 is 4.

items.prompt: Most people in a town earn modest salaries but a few earn huge amounts. Which average better represents the majority?

options.label: The mean, because the huge amounts matter most
The median, because it is not overly influenced by a few higher incomes

items.explain: The median is usually used for skewed data so that it represents the majority rather than being overly influenced by a few much higher incomes.

items.prompt: You drive to a town at 30 mph and back at 60 mph, over the same distance. Which average gives the constant speed that would take the same total time?
items.explain: A harmonic mean of speeds gives the constant speed that covers the same distance in the same time, unlike an arithmetic mean or median of speeds.

items.prompt: A class's test scores range from 40 to 90. Which value could not be an average of those scores?
items.explain: All averages of a collection lie within its bounds, between the maximum and minimum.

items.prompt: A shop wants the most popular shirt colour among its sales. Which average can handle colours, which are categories?
items.explain: The mode is the most common value and can be used when the data is categorical rather than numeric.

items.prompt: A poll averages answers from 500 people drawn from a city. What is that mean called, compared with the mean of the whole group?
items.explain: A mean from a sample of a larger group is called the sample mean, to distinguish it from the group mean of the underlying distribution.
